statement: Pinned Nunchuk subpage describes six extension bytes from register 0xA40008: byte 0 holds stick X, byte 1 stick Y, bytes 2–4 hold accelerometer X/Y/Z high eight bits, and byte 5 packs the three pairs of low accelerometer bits plus active-low C and Z buttons. Acceleration fields therefore form three 10-bit quantities; the byte layout is stated after decryption.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew pinned community documentation; no authenticated retail capture
applicability.scope: Nunchuck > Data Format. Source-only, not a physical acceptance result. Compare wii-c5-extension-packing and WiiBrew MotionPlus pass-through: extension bytes are not interchangeable when MotionPlus is active.
